scope: The former Santa Rita Hotel on South Scott Avenue in Tucson, with the original Mission Revival building, west entry and 1917 south addition, circa 1937.

originalReview.notes: The full Qualla front shows the stepped Scott Avenue frontage, ornamental square frieze and Mission Revival arches. The matching Boston Public Library reverse names the U.S. publisher and the printer and carries no copyright notice.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla postcard is a scanned copy of Tichnor Brothers item 65324. Its Boston Public Library record and both printed sides support its published U.S. public-domain basis. Other Qualla images were excluded because their authorship, date or original publication could not be matched with equal confidence.
